sources.snippet: Overview SmolLM-135M-Instruct is a 135-million-parameter instruction-tuned language model built by HuggingFaceTB designed for on-device inference and local deployment. The model trains on curated educational data including Cosmopedia v2 (28B tokens of synthetic textbooks), Python-Edu (4B tokens of educational Python samples), and FineWeb-Edu (220B tokens of educational web content).
